measurement_limits: All timer and update rates are emulated measurements, not physical calculator FPS.
App::map_clock_ms watch observes update starts, not completed presentation events.
The complete 59-frame combat aggregate includes initial Continue/loading, idle animation and save input; it is not a pure steady-state frame distribution.
Resource time is measured within provider reads, and the scene resource total includes resource calls made during both update and render.
PC samples cover 256-byte buckets that may span adjacent functions.
Firebird SP804 polling adds emulated cycles; host wall time, emulated ticks and physical calculator performance are not interchangeable.
The clamped dt and low rendering rate can skip source animation frames; crossing a complete authored duration does not prove every source frame is cached.
Startup excludes program loader time. The separate startup-plus-first-render read residual must not be confused with all-run resource totals.
No browser compositor FPS or physical USB-connected calculator was measured.
